items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Well, my grandfather died when I was real young and I never even got to know him real well.

ctx.x: Oh, about your grandfather, did he play by music or was he a faker or both?

Well, my grandfather died when I was real young and I never even got to know him real well. I don't know whether he played by music or whether he was a faker. I never did get to know that. My Uncle Jasper Hug on the drums, he played by music. I know he used to play with quite a number of bands that read music, so I know he read.
